fields.name: listing_id
fields.description: Ticker at listing, used as the listing key throughout the dataset.

fields.name: listing_date
fields.description: First trading day (IPO, ADR offering or direct listing) or SPAC merger closing date.

fields.name: sector
fields.description: Sector classification of the source IPO dataset (blank for two listings: see docs/limitations.md).

fields.name: offer_price_usd
fields.description: Offer price per share, or per ADS for ADS issuers; the reference price for direct listings and SPAC mergers. Unit: USD.

fields.name: ads_ratio
fields.description: Ordinary shares per ADS for issuers listed through ADSs; blank otherwise.

fields.name: shares_post_offering_m
fields.description: Shares outstanding after the offering, all economic classes (after closing for SPAC mergers, excluding unvested earnout and sponsor shares), reconciled to the prospectus. Unit: million shares.

fields.name: split_factor
fields.description: Cumulative split factor from listing to the 2 October 2026 close (shares held at the end date per share held at listing).

fields.name: price_end_usd
fields.description: Close on 2 October 2026 per share (per ADS for ADS issuers); for acquired companies, the consideration per share at completion; for companies delisted to over-the-counter markets, the OTC close. Unit: USD.

fields.name: price_end_note
fields.description: How price_end_usd was set where it is not a close on the end date or a recorded takeout price (implied by the recorded company value).

fields.name: value_at_listing_usd_bn
fields.description: shares_post_offering_m x offer_price_usd / ads_ratio, in billions. Unit: USD bn.

fields.name: value_end_usd_bn
fields.description: Long-term value created: shares_post_offering_m x split_factor x price_end_usd / ads_ratio, in billions, at the 2 October 2026 close. Unit: USD bn.

fields.name: n_holding_lines
fields.description: Number of holder lines for the listing in holdings.csv.

fields.name: valuation_date
fields.description: Performance end date for every value in the row (2026-10-02).
